definitions.gloss: Japanese long onion; Welsh onion; Japanese leek
definitions.explanation: A long white-and-green onion commonly used in Japanese cooking, known in English as Japanese leek, Welsh onion, or green onion. The white part is especially prized in eastern Japan.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}ねぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{刻|きざ}んだ→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧。
examples.english: I chopped the long onion finely.
Adding long onion to a hot pot brings out sweetness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長|なが}ねぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小口切|こぐちぎ}り→小口切り：23076_koguchigiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散|ち}らす→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Sprinkling thinly sliced long onion rings on miso soup as a finishing touch greatly enhances the flavor.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (long) and ねぎ (onion/scallion). Refers specifically to the thick, long variety of ねぎ with a substantial white portion, as opposed to smaller varieties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長|なが}ねぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刻|きざ}む→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧ (to chop green onion)
- {長|なが}ねぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (the white part of the onion)
- {長|なが}ねぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小口切|こぐちぎ}り→小口切り：23076_koguchigiri⟧ (onion sliced into thin rings)
- {長|なが}ねぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (the green part of the onion)

In eastern Japan (⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧), the thick white part is preferred, while in western Japan (⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧), thinner green onions ({青|あお}ねぎ) are more commonly used. Recipes often specify {長|なが}ねぎ to distinguish from other ねぎ varieties.
